# Synthetic RSK Fixtures

All payload values, people, organizations, contacts, descriptions, and product
content in this directory are invented for Minos tests. The fixtures retain
public RSK protocol field names and the real protocol resource identifier
`00CD10` so they exercise the expected wire shape; those protocol identifiers
are not claimed to be invented.

`manifest.json` records the SHA-256 digest and byte count of each fixture. The
fixtures model the expected response shape only and are safe to commit.
